title: helianthemum teretifolium
intro: Helianthemum teretifolium, commonly known as Rockrose or Frostweed, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum teretifolium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of Helianthemum teretifolium's health benefits and therapeutic actions.
